summary_en: Kinden acquired all voting rights of Hiroden Corporation (code 1948) through a tender offer for 3,714,499 shares (42.53% stake) settled July 13, 2026, followed by a stock consolidation on September 29, 2026, and Hiroden's acquisition of remaining 6 shares from Mitsubishi Electric (51.36% holder) on September 30, 2026, making Hiroden a wholly-owned subsidiary.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Making of Hiroden Corporation a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary
translation_en_brief:
Kinden Corporation announced the completion of acquiring Hiroden Corporation (TSE Standard Market, code 1948) as a wholly-owned subsidiary through a series of coordinated transactions. Kinden launched a public tender offer on May 26, 2026, acquiring 3,714,499 shares of Hiroden at settlement on July 13, 2026, representing a 42.53% stake. At that time, Mitsubishi Electric held the remaining controlling stake of 4,485,620 shares (51.36%), while Hiroden held treasury stock of 236,400 shares.

Following the tender offer settlement, Hiroden executed a stock consolidation effective September 29, 2026, which consolidated the shares held by minority shareholders. On the same date (September 30, 2026), Hiroden acquired the final 6 remaining shares held by Mitsubishi Electric—representing the consolidated equivalent of Mitsubishi Electric's original 4,485,620-share stake after the consolidation—through a treasury stock acquisition. This final step was funded through a third-party allocation capital increase underwritten by Kinden and a reduction in Hiroden's capital and capital reserve.

With the completion of the treasury stock acquisition on September 30, 2026, Hiroden became wholly owned by Kinden, with Kinden holding all voting rights. The series of transactions that began with the May 26, 2026 tender offer initiation concluded as planned, establishing Hiroden as Kinden's wholly-owned subsidiary engaged in electrical equipment construction and related commercial sales.
